neighbours.label: the sentence-final full stop ('.' or '。') at the end of a prose sentence
fire: The garden behind the old house was full of roses in June.
Our neighbors adopted a small brown dog from the shelter.
The museum will stay open late on Friday evenings this summer.
这里的葡萄园面积非常大。
My brother finally finished painting the kitchen walls.
The train to the coast leaves every hour from platform four.
The committee approved the new budget after a long debate.
她每天早上都去公园散步。
quiet: Was the garden behind the old house full of roses in June?
Our neighbors adopted a small brown dog from the shelter!
Will the museum stay open late on Friday evenings this summer?
这里的葡萄园面积非常大吗？
My brother finally finished painting the kitchen walls!
Does the train to the coast leave every hour from platform four?
Did the committee approve the new budget after a long debate?
她每天早上都去公园散步吗？

notes: Card: '。' x21 and '.' x11 of top 32, all sentence-final; broad (3.3%). The - pole is '.' inside version numbers, so near misses end with other punctuation and contain no periods.
